descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · TFA-92585 AC 3 · “List is grouped by patient, pending first, completed at the bottom”. Mixed: stated part — a task marked done moves to the completed part; our part — Undo bringing it back to pending (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Approach · TC-07 Task Export · S07 Existing spec: a task completed on the cross-patient screen moves to the completed part and comes back on Undo

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 On the view the list is grouped by patient, pending tasks first and completed tasks at the bottom; every task shows which patient it belongs to (UAT TC-07; TFA-92585 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U1 One consolidated in-app end-of-day view lists every open task across all of the physician's patients, each attributed to its patient (UAT TC-07; TFA-92585 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given One Hospital patient with an open task 'Recheck potassium <ts>'

When Rounding list → Task Export → Mark task done → open Finished Tasks → Undo

Then The task moves to Finished Tasks, then back to pending; rounding:list shows done false at the end

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions (Hospital only; Nursing Home is S06)

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)
